label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The restaurant is recognizable: repeated tables, left booths, individual chairs, hanging lamps, corner windows, lined ceiling and right foreground plant are present. Furniture and vegetation are substantially simplified.

The authored view retains left-side booths, central and right dining furniture, rear/right windows, overhead pendants and right foreground vegetation. Spacing and chair orientations are only approximate.

Tables, seating and ceiling clearance remain functionally recognizable and broadly plausible. Chair backs and foreground lamps are comparatively bulky, without destroying the overall scale correspondence.

Light ceiling and tabletops contrast with dark seating, floor and pendants. This preserves the main tonal organization, although bulbous lamps and slab-like chairs lose distinctive reference silhouettes.
The entire dining area remains legible with bright windows and coherent soft shading. Heavy grain and flat illumination weaken the bright daylight atmosphere but do not obscure the main content.
Complementary views show furniture sides, table pedestals, lamp volumes and changed occlusions, establishing a spatial scene rather than a single textured plane.

Actual mesh components have nonempty geometry, assigned materials and traversable parent hierarchies. Examples include architecture Box, booth Box.073, tabletop Box.095, chair Box.113 and pendant Ball.010; their material records contain connected surface shaders.

dimension_scores.evidence: The major restaurant arrangement is recognizable, but generic chairs, rounded lamp bodies, sparse plants and blank windows substantially reduce resemblance.

Tables have pedestals and lamps have suspension cords. Seating supports look insufficiently grounded in several views, and the very large foreground tabletop has a disproportionately small central support.
Broad grayscale contrast is retained, but blocky seating and closed, flattened lamp forms lose the reference's characteristic furniture design.
Severe render noise, uniformly simple surfaces, blank window panels and rigid vegetation make the result look like an unfinished blockout.
Broad left/center/right zoning and corner windows survive; repetitive chair orientation and loose table-to-chair relationships weaken the dining layout.
Most furniture fits the room plausibly. Tall rectangular chair backs, flattened oversized foreground lamps and the stretched foreground table reduce proportional fidelity.
Objects are readable with consistent shading, but grain, weak material differentiation and flat window brightness substantially diminish daylight and surface quality.

Major architectural and furniture categories are covered with repeated instances. Chair arms and pedestal-style chair bases, fuller planting and finer ceiling/window details are missing or simplified.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
